channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Thompson honors football state champions with ring ceremony
item.description: Thompson celebrated its second-straight state football championship with its state title rings, which include numerous details honoring the Warriors’ seventh title in program history.

item.title: Thompson finishes Wetumpka tournament with 5-0 record
item.description: Thompson continued its perfect season with five wins over Gulf Shores, Enterprise, Southside, Saraland and Houston Academy at the Wetumpka Tournament.

item.title: Briarwood rallies to upset No. 1 Chelsea, avenge playoff loss
item.description: Briarwood rallied from a goal down to take down No. 1 Chelsea at home in the area opener a year after the Lions’ season ended at the Hornets’ hands.

item.title: Montevallo falls late to Lee in opening round of Gulf South Conference Tournament
item.description: Montevallo fell to the Lee Flames in the quarterfinals of the Gulf South Conference Tournament

item.title: Thompson alum Carson Freeman makes nationals, UM's Cole Hunt wins NCAA Super Regional title
item.description: The University of Montevallo's Cole Hunt won the NCAA Super Region II championship while Thompson alum Carson Freeman and Jake Chisholm qualified for nationals.

item.title: UM's Emily Houser named GSC Freshman of the Year
item.description: The University of Montevallo's Emily Houser was named Gulf South Conference Freshman of the Year for women's basketball, becoming the third-straight Falcon to earn the honor.

item.title: UM's Derek Moore wins GSC Player of the Year, makes All-GSC team with Fussell, Curry
item.description: The University of Montevallo's Derek Moore was named the Gulf South Conference Player of the Year and joined his teammates Brandon Fussell and Jaylen Curry on the All-GSC team.

item.title: Thompson alum Bradley Franklin runs fastest 60m hurdles time in D-I with Samford
item.description: Thompson alum Bradley Franklin ran the fastest 60-meter hurdles time in the country to win the SoCon indoor championship with Samford and advance to the NCAA championship.

item.title: Chelsea’s Ty Cason, Hudson Williams sign distance scholarships
item.description: Chelsea’s Ty Cason signed with Mississippi State track and field and Hudson Williams signed with Wallace State cross-country at a joint signing ceremony after their accomplished careers.

item.title: Pelham Athletics Hall of Fame inducts seven-member class of 2025
item.description: Pelham inducted its seven-member Class of 2025 for the Pelham Athletics Hall of Fame, including Chris Adams, Justin Allison, Emily Bell Casey, Lauren D’Alessio Marsh, Patrick McDonald, Michael Proctor and Seth Torman.
